title: fun and well structured tour
text: The guided tour helped you to see what you were looking at, and how to interpret what you saw. Otherwise, without the guide, it would just be a walk around a park with a few structures to look at. Eduardo had a lovely laid back approach with knowledge, insight, and a sense of humour. He also had some great tips for other things to visit in Barcelona, slightly off the beaten track.
author: soosana2024

title: Well worth a visit with a tour guide
text: Wow the park was everything I expected ted - well worth going with a tour guide to point out all the hidden gems and knowledge. Even in the rain this was not dulled. The views across the the city over to the Sagrada Família were amazing! Our tour guide Gemma spoke very good English and was extremely knowledgeable! Once the tour was over we could remain in the park to wander around by ourselves.

title: Nature tour in the city
text: This was a wonderful tour at Park Güell. Esther was an excellent tour guide. She was funny, engaging, and deeply knowledgeable about the park. Not only did she take us to all the famous spots but she also recommended places in the park to visit once the tour was over. As both a first time visitor to the park and a solo traveler, this was an excellent way to experience Park Güell.
